description.narrative: Number of approved policy, legal and institutional reforms

comment.narrative: No policies legal and institutional reforms before the project

National Legal Aid Policy approved October 2018 as per OMss clarification in the mail. The development of a legal aid policy understood as a national strategy on legal aid is an essential step in this regard. It usually takes the form of a national policy document adopted at Parliament andor Cabinet level supplemented by specific legislation and regulations together with operational guidelines. It provides for a comprehensive regulatory and implementation framework at country level for the administration provision and monitoring of legal aid services.
